bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; requiring the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency to maintain a web-based permit application tracker; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 116.07, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 116.07, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 4o.+]

[+Permit application tracker.+]

[+The commissioner must establish, maintain, and continually improve a web-based application that allows applicants and members of the public to track the status of permit applications submitted to the agency. The information available through the tracker must include the facility name, permit program category, permit type, facility identification number, permit number, and the dates on which steps in the permitting process were completed. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; requiring the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency to maintain a web-based permit application tracker; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 116.07, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 116.07, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 4o.

Permit application tracker.

The commissioner must establish, maintain, and continually improve a web-based application that allows applicants and members of the public to track the status of permit applications submitted to the agency. The information available through the tracker must include the facility name, permit program category, permit type, facility identification number, permit number, and the dates on which steps in the permitting process were completed.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: The commissioner must establish, maintain, and continually improve a web-based application that allows applicants and members of the public to track the status of permit applications submitted to the agency. The information available through the tracker must include the facility name, permit program category, permit type, facility identification number, permit number, and the dates on which steps in the permitting process were completed.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
